claims.evidence: Witness confirms wooden pallets with slatted top and cut-out openings, but photos do not show standard type details (e.g., 4-way entry, stringer vs block) or any markings.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: Witness notes visible wear, dirt, and uneven wood surfaces; photos show used condition rather than clearly clean.
Photos cannot confirm whether water was added; witness only reports visual dryness/used appearance.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale reading, receipt, or video of weighing is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Unclear pallet type/standard (stringer vs block, 4-way entry) and exact dimensions—affects fit for racking/forklift handling and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo with a tape measure showing length/width/height and a shot of the underside showing entry points (4-way vs 2-way) plus any stamp/marking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used wooden pallets with unknown dimensions/type.

risks.risk: Condition issues not fully visible: broken boards, loose nails/screws, cracks, missing slats—affects safety and load rating.
risks.proof: Close-up video walking the pallet edges and underside, showing every slat and any cracks/loose fasteners; include a shot of any damaged boards.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used pallets with possible damage (lower load suitability).

risks.risk: Treatment/grade not shown (HT vs MB, fumigation status, chemical treatment)—matters for export, food use, and compliance.
risks.proof: Photo of any stamp/brand on the pallet (e.g., IPPC mark) and a close-up of the treatment code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated/unknown treatment risk (restricted use).

risks.risk: Quantity ambiguity: photos show stacked pallets, but it’s unclear whether the sale is one pallet or multiple and how many.
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full stack count (or a count method) and/or a video panning across the entire quantity being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case assumption for quantity clarity (treated as fewer units than claimed).

risks.risk: Load capacity/usage history unknown—could be from heavy loads or improper storage, reducing durability.
risks.proof: Photos of any deformation/warping and underside wear patterns; plus a short video showing flex/condition under light handling.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as low-to-medium durability used pallets.

risks.risk: Seller’s stated total weight may not match actual quantity—affects per-kg value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: Video of the certified scale weighing the exact items (showing the scale display and the pallet(s) being weighed).
risks.if_unproven: Priced without relying on the claimed weight.

proof_requests: Provide exact pallet dimensions (length/width/height) with a tape measure in-frame.
Show underside entry points (4-way vs 2-way) and whether it’s stringer or block pallet.
Send close-up photos/videos of all slats and edges to confirm no broken boards or loose nails/screws.
Show any IPPC/HT/MB stamp or treatment marking on the wood.
Confirm total quantity being sold (how many pallets) with a wide shot or countable stack video.
If weight matters, share a video of the certified scale reading the exact pallets being weighed.
response.reason: The witness can confirm the item is wooden pallets, but key pricing drivers (exact type/size, condition details, treatment markings, and quantity/weight) are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
